content: If the patient does not have albuminuria or coronary artery disease (CAD), the following treatment options are recommended: If initiating therapy with a single medication, select one agent from the following classes: an angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEi), an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), a calcium channel blocker (CCB), or a diuretic. If starting therapy with two medications, choose two agents from two different classes among the following: an ACEi or ARB, a CCB, and a diuretic.
